bounds: Three fixed terminal operations, page size two, and two completed cycles; two operations lack proof permanently and the third can settle.
limitations: Row locks select distinct operations and the database clock places selected operations after existing unselected work before remote I/O.
No unbounded backlog, new arrivals, worker availability, unbounded progress or implementation refinement is proved.
fairness: The finite fixed backlog completes when page selection, each selected failure/success action and cycle completion are weakly fair. The existing database-clock ordering assumption is required.
